subject: Compiler directives
notes: kb/Work PB1360 landed (w1004b). A directive line is never a join target: the logical-line builder records whether the latest logical line is a directive line and a fixed-form hyphen line, or the line after a floating literal continuation indicator, that follows one is COBOL2696 and is not joined, in both reference formats. A directive whose words run onto a following ordinary line was already rejected by every directive stage (S1A-S1D); IF and EVALUATE lines are directive lines like the rest (7.3.16.3 SR1, 7.3.13.3 SR2).
